t: Epic buys ArtStation, drops asset marketplace fee to 12% | PC Gamer
s: April 30, 2021 - The site also runs a marketplace for game assets and digital illustration resources, and as the first order of business, Epic has dropped ArtStation's standard marketplace fee from 30% to 12%, matching its Epic Games Store revenue cut.

t: Epic Games buys artist portfolio site ArtStation | The Verge
s: May 3, 2021 - Epic Games has acquired ArtStation, an online marketplace for digital artists. The two companies announced that seller fees for artists on ArtStation would be reduced and that ArtStation would continue to operate independently.
